ruleDefinitions.name: PUA - Wsudo Suspicious Execution
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects usage of wsudo (Windows Sudo Utility). Which is a tool that let the user execute programs with different permissions (System, Trusted Installer, Administrator...etc)

sequences.query: ((process_path = RGX("\\\\wsudo\\\.exe$") OR process_original_file_name = "wsudo\.exe" OR process_description = "Windows\ sudo\ utility" OR parent_process_path = RGX("\\\\wsudo\\-bridge\\\.exe$")) OR (process_command_line = RGX(".*\\-u\\ System.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\-uSystem.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\-u\\ TrustedInstaller.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\-uTrustedInstaller.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ \\-\\-ti\\ .*")))
